beats.does: Vance snaps his shoulder blades down hard, lighting his lat muscles bright green.
beats.says: Pull shoulders away from ears first.

beats.shot: Wide dynamic camera sweep around Vance
beats.does: Vance lowers smoothly into a dead hang from the invisible bar.
beats.says: Start from a dead straight hang.

beats.shot: Medium low angle on Vance's torso
beats.does: Vance pulls his shoulder blades down and back with robotic precision.
beats.says: Depressing the scapula engages the lats.

beats.does: Vance drives his chest smoothly up toward his hands.
beats.says: Pull your chest toward your hands.

beats.shot: Dynamic 3D camera sweep from the side
beats.does: Vance lowers his body down from the invisible bar with slow control, lats glowing green.
beats.says: Lower down slowly with total control.

beats.shot: Wide shot on Vance facing the screen
beats.does: Vance reaches the bottom hang and immediately begins pulling his shoulders down again.
